devdoc.details: Escrow and EscrowV2 expose the same Deposit and Intent ABI used here. Governance can update      the extension fee for every deposit using this guardian address.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

extendIntent(address,uint256,bytes32,uin.details: The compatible Escrow enforces guardian authorization, non-zero time, and the cumulative      five-day lifetime cap. All state and token movements revert atomically on payment failure.

params._additionalTime: Seconds to add to the current expiry.
params._escrow: Whitelisted Escrow or EscrowV2 holding the deposit and intent.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setExtensionFeeBpsPerHour(uint256).details: A zero fee disables extensions until governance configures a non-zero fee.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: IntentGuardian

escrowRegistry().notice: Escrow registry used to authorize compatible escrows.

extendIntent(address,uint256,bytes32,uin.notice: Prepays a deposit's maker and extends a live intent.

extensionFeeBpsPerHour().notice: Governance-configured hourly extension fee in basis points of the locked intent amount.

quoteExtensionCost(uint256,uint256).notice: Quotes the exact upward-rounded prepaid extension cost.

setExtensionFeeBpsPerHour(uint256).notice: Updates the hourly extension fee for all deposits using this guardian.

userdoc.notice: Extends live Escrow intents in exchange for a prepaid, non-refundable fee.
